3143.title: Protocol self-update restarts during active turns
3143.rootCauseOneLine: A successful protocol self-update requests daemon shutdown without gating on active threads, and shutdown explicitly terminates every provider process group.
3143.proposedFix: Decouple provider workers from daemon lifetime with reconnectable transport and validated adoption; define an explicit active-turn drain policy as a mitigation.
3143.caveats: The repository-level restart and provider-termination chain was verified; the reporter's private protocol history and host logs were not accessed.
